notes.title: Patch 1.2 16th of April
notes.content:
New:
[list]- added shake to zombie death[/list]
[list]- added red-white blinkig on zombie hit[/list]
[list]- added sound to zombie death[/list]
Fixed:
[list]- various sound bugs[/list]
[list]- lightning bug with splatter on some levels[/list]
